plugins.name: umo-sdlc
plugins.description: UMO SDLC v1 — doc bucket structure, design, lifecycle, and audit. Service buckets (services/<name>/docs/) are spec-driven and anchored on PASSPORT.md, the canonical service identity record. Library buckets (repo root or domain repo) are knowledge stores. Three skills: docs-setup, docs-lifecycle, docs-audit. No planning, memory, review, or KPI scope in v1.
